_doc: REAL live-model e2e (PB-186): the user runs /plan-my-day; the real skill (claude #1) lays the day's WORK BLOCKS around the persona's fixed anchors using the actual Step 1c rules from plan.txt, and the real persona (claude #2) supplies the anchors in character. The contract: each mid-day work block is a FULL session_length_min unit — the skill must DROP a block that can't fit a full unit + break rather than shrink it (the pre-fix bug produced 90/60/45-min blocks). Only the final wind-down block may run short. persona_mode=live → two real claude calls (genuine agent-to-agent comm); the agent↔agent transcript + the asserted layout are written into the result.json and rendered to HTML by report.py. Skips cleanly (SEAM, never a synthetic pass) if the claude CLI is absent.
anchors: Lunch 13:00-14:00. Nap 14:00-15:30. Free to work from 15:30. Pre-football fuel (meal) 18:30-19:00, then get-ready 19:00-19:30. Football at 21:00 (hard anchor, wrap everything before it). Wind-down begins ~20:15.
display: plan-my-day/blocks — LIVE: skill lays full 90-min blocks, flexes the count (PB-186)
